# New York Weekly

> > New York Weekly is a digital publication operated by Matrix Global Brands, providing news, lifestyle, and cultural content with editorial independence.

Published by Matrix Global LLC and part of the Matrix Global Media Network, New York Weekly maintains editorial independence while offering branded content opportunities. The publication is associated with Ora Fiduciary (Cook Islands) Limited in Avarua, Rarotonga, Cook Islands.
